palette.notes: Close-ups show khaki, olive and tan ramps of 3-4 steps that darken into warm brown, a single red or yellow vest as the hero accent, and near-black outlines. Stages are sepia ruins or dusky purple stone; muzzle flashes are pale yellow. No metrics file.

lighting: Painted-in top-left light on every sprite: highlights on hair, cheekbones and knuckles, warm brown shadow on the far side. Backgrounds are lit like illustrations; explosions and muzzle flashes briefly light the scene.
silhouette: Big heads, huge hands and feet, a gun as long as the torso, wide stances; thick dark outline all around. Even at 1x the pose reads (thumbs-up, crouch-and-fire).

motion.timing: Hand-drawn, frame-rich arcade animation with lots of secondary motion on loose gear (known_for); the clip shows fire poses with a separate flash frame. No frame timings measured.

texture: Dense hand-pixelled detail: rubble, crumbling balconies, broken walls; weapon pickups are chunky bevelled letter tiles (H, F, S, L) with a light top edge and dark bottom edge, read like buttons.
camera: Side-scrolling view pushing forward; foes and a giant stone face fill the background while the hero stays small at the bottom.

acting.enters: Enemies arrive mid-gag (busy, distracted) instead of ready to fight; the driver hops in and out of the tank (wiki).
acting.acts: Slapstick reactions: foes panic, flee, crowd around the hero. Personality is in poses: grinning thumbs-up, open-mouth shout while firing.
acting.exits: Characters bail with a gag, e.g. the driver jumps clear before the tank rams and explodes (wiki).
acting.depth: One plane of play; background shows ruined streets, a parked car and a huge carved head looming behind the action.

techniques: thick dark outline + warm 3-4 step ramps
cartoon proportions: big head, hands, feet and gun
separate muzzle-flash frame over earthy palette
bevelled letter tile as a readable pickup icon
running gag: same character beaten and back again
feel: warm khaki ramps + thick outline + big head and hands + flash frame + slapstick = funny, alive action
for_fred: Exaggerate Fred's pose sprites the Metal Slug way: bigger head and fins, a wide stance, one bright accent colour. Make him a running gag: knocked out of frame by the punchline, back next beat a little battered, with a new reaction pose each exit so the repeat never looks like a loop.
